framework_phases.name: Reconnaissance
attack_surfaces_identified: Client Monitor Web UI (GitHub Pages static hosting)

hunting_vectors.details: All credentials (LiveKit, Deepgram, DeepSeek, n8n) managed via gitignored .env and environment variables.
Monitor panel uses textContent or strict DOM binding for dynamic user transcripts; no unescaped innerHTML injections.
n8n dispatcher targets validated HTTPS webhook endpoint exclusively.

hunting_vectors.vector: AI Safety / Prompt Injection & System Exfiltration
hunting_vectors.details: System prompts in agent/prompts.py enforce strict identity boundary (Sofía) with instruction priority shielding.

hunting_vectors.vector: WebRTC Token TTL & Room Grants Exposure
hunting_vectors.details: Tokens issued by make_token.py have strict 1-hour expiration (TTL) and non-administrative room_join grants.

hunting_vectors.vector: Data Protection & GDPR (Luxembourg eIDAS / PII Scrubbing)
hunting_vectors.details: Transcripts store minimal business contact information for event quoting; audio streams are non-persisted on public endpoints.

disproved_findings.reason: make_token.py strictly reads environment variables and executes in local CLI context, never deployed to public web root.
Twilio is strictly forbidden by architecture rules; no twilio packages or libraries exist in dependencies.
